name: NG exhaustion chain Phase-2 P-O-X successor ancestry incremental test
purpose: Test whether older P-O-X ancestry adds out-of-time predictive value once the first successor exhaustion has become its own causally confirmed event.
target: successor oriented return from successor structural endpoint+5 to endpoint+60
baseline_features_available_by_successor: successor polarity relation to immediate parent current event
ancestry_additions: whether the P-O-X current event had same versus opposite polarity relative to its latest X predecessor
interaction of that older branch with successor polarity relation
model: fixed Ridge(alpha=1.0) with standardized numeric inputs; no tuning on test blocks

result.interpretation: Older P-O-X branch information is not a stable incremental predictor once the successor exhaustion has become its own event. It materially worsens the first replication test and yields only small later improvements. This supports a rolling/re-origin checkpoint interpretation rather than assuming unchanged inherited P-O-X state through the successor.

boundary.note: A successor checkpoint may still use any older information that survives a future predeclared OOT test, but no older state is presumed active by default.
